dedup: each finding is fingerprinted; a fingerprint already acted on or claimed is dropped before the call, so a tick with nothing new makes no call; the attempt count is written per fingerprint before the call (a failed write means no call) and a fingerprint at STAFF_MAX_ATTEMPTS is recorded failed with no call; AGENT_CALL_FP is the sorted fingerprint set plus note:<id> per taken operator note, so the same batch is the same call key. BH-6823: a taken operator note also opens the call (POST /api/staff/chat/take claims it and counts the attempt before the call); each note is taken at most staff.chat.attempts_max times, then failed by the take with no call; rc 0 with no reply for a note is unanswered and terminal; every other exit releases the note
note: BH-5561: the generic staff heartbeat, at most one model turn per agent tick and only for new findings (bin/staff.sh tick <agent>, cron/lanes/729-staff.cron). Capped per call by AGENT_CALL_BUDGET_USD_STAFF_TICK=STAFF_LLM_MAX_USD (lanes.d staff, default 0.60). The model is model_routes stage.staff-tick (one route for every agent; the agent is STAFF_AGENT); no route is no call. BH-6823: operator chat notes ride the same call (## Messages in, replies out), so a tick still makes at most one call. Off: STAFF_ENABLED=0, flags/staff-off-all, flags/staff-off-<agent>.
